name: the-reference-frame-job-records-its-ffmpeg
find:
echo "### ffmpeg on ${{ runner.os }} (${{ runner.arch }}), shard ${{ matrix.shard.name }}"
            echo '```'
            ffmpeg -version | head -n 1
breaks: the job where MAX_CHANGED_FRACTION's reading was taken stops writing down which ffmpeg produced it, so a run that fails every reference frame cannot be told from a deliberate redesign (#792, #552)
